packageRules.description: The Vite+ toolchain moves as one (ADR 1), so both catalog entries go together
TypeScript is warp's one runtime dependency and its analysis API, so a bump is read before merging
A pnpm bump is never routine: pnpm enforces the install policy, so its releases are read before merging
prBodyNotes: Read this release's notes and migration guide before merging: pnpm enforces the install policy in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, and a bump to it can change what that policy means.
